description: The bar chart compares the accuracy of two models, MMAU and MMAR, across different audio processing tasks. The vertical axis represents accuracy in percentage, ranging from 0 to 70, with increments of 10. The horizontal axis lists the tasks: "Construct," "Audio-Reasoner," and "Qwen-2.5-Omni." For the "Construct" task, MMAU has an accuracy of approximately 50%, while MMAR is around 40%. In the "Audio-Reasoner" task, MMAU shows a higher accuracy of about 60%, compared to MMAR's roughly 50%. For the "Qwen-2.5-Omni" task, both models have similar accuracies, with MMAU at approximately 65% and MMAR at about 60%. The bars are color-coded, with MMAU represented in blue and MMAR in purple. The chart does not indicate any specific sorting or emphasis on the bars.
